description: Cliff block: a tall rock mass with ridged noise, horizontal strata ledges and banded colour, flat on the ground. Pivot at the centre of the base. Piece: cliff (cliff_rock). Closed (watertight).

roughness.desc: noise and ledge strength (0 = smooth block)

base_mask.note: m = 0 at the base so it stays flat on the ground; the corners are pulled in a little

ledges.note: strata: each layer is pushed in or out by its own random amount, with a slope inside the layer; the base stays flat

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const b = point(0, 'band', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]); @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, 0.62 + 0.6 * b);
